leverage_definitions.audit_scope: USD us-gaap original 10-K/10-Q instant facts matched on issuer,end,form,filed,accession; no leverage ratio calculated
leverage_definitions.capital_lease_direct_total_reconciliatio: Diagnostic only: direct reported total versus exact current+non-current pair; no debt value or leverage ratio is persisted.
leverage_definitions.complexity: low: one debt tag plus Assets
leverage_definitions.double_counting_risk: low aggregation risk, but material scope omission risk
leverage_definitions.economic_interpretation: Long-term debt intensity; the tag excludes capital leases and does not establish total debt.
leverage_definitions.review_recommendation: Do not label TotalDebt/Assets; acceptable only if the project explicitly chooses a long-term-debt proxy.

leverage_definitions.audit_scope: USD us-gaap original 10-K/10-Q instant facts matched on issuer,end,form,filed,accession; no leverage ratio calculated
leverage_definitions.capital_lease_direct_total_reconciliatio: Diagnostic only: direct reported total versus exact current+non-current pair; no debt value or leverage ratio is persisted.
leverage_definitions.complexity: medium: two mutually classified components plus Assets
leverage_definitions.double_counting_risk: low conditional risk: only sum the exact current and non-current pair from the same filing; do not add LongTermDebt or lease tags
leverage_definitions.economic_interpretation: Current and non-current long-term debt, both described as excluding capital leases.
leverage_definitions.review_recommendation: Most interpretable debt-only TotalDebt/Assets candidate, conditional on approving lease exclusion.

leverage_definitions.audit_scope: USD us-gaap original 10-K/10-Q instant facts matched on issuer,end,form,filed,accession; no leverage ratio calculated
leverage_definitions.capital_lease_direct_total_reconciliatio: Diagnostic only: direct reported total versus exact current+non-current pair; no debt value or leverage ratio is persisted.
leverage_definitions.complexity: medium: two mutually classified components plus Assets
leverage_definitions.double_counting_risk: low conditional risk: exact current/non-current pair only; no FinanceLeaseLiability or OperatingLeaseLiability addition
leverage_definitions.economic_interpretation: Long-term debt and capital-lease obligations, split into current and non-current components.
leverage_definitions.review_recommendation: Economically broader historical candidate, but coverage is lower and capital-lease versus finance-lease treatment needs approval.

leverage_definitions.audit_scope: USD us-gaap original 10-K/10-Q instant facts matched on issuer,end,form,filed,accession; no leverage ratio calculated
leverage_definitions.capital_lease_direct_total_reconciliatio: Diagnostic only: direct reported total versus exact current+non-current pair; no debt value or leverage ratio is persisted.
leverage_definitions.complexity: low: one reported total plus Assets
leverage_definitions.double_counting_risk: lowest aggregation risk: no components are added
leverage_definitions.economic_interpretation: Single reported long-term-debt-and-capital-lease amount including current maturities.
leverage_definitions.review_recommendation: Safest reported-total formulation where available, but expected coverage is low; do not supplement with components.

leverage_definitions.audit_scope: USD us-gaap original 10-K/10-Q instant facts matched on issuer,end,form,filed,accession; no leverage ratio calculated
leverage_definitions.capital_lease_direct_total_reconciliatio: Diagnostic only: direct reported total versus exact current+non-current pair; no debt value or leverage ratio is persisted.
leverage_definitions.double_counting_risk: medium: current/non-current labels are complementary, but lease scope differs across components
leverage_definitions.economic_interpretation: Current debt (including current maturities and capital leases) plus non-current long-term debt excluding capital leases.
leverage_definitions.review_recommendation: Candidate only for human review; it is not a clean all-lease-inclusive or all-lease-exclusive definition.

leverage_definitions.audit_scope: USD us-gaap original 10-K/10-Q instant facts matched on issuer,end,form,filed,accession; no leverage ratio calculated
leverage_definitions.capital_lease_direct_total_reconciliatio: Diagnostic only: direct reported total versus exact current+non-current pair; no debt value or leverage ratio is persisted.
leverage_definitions.double_counting_risk: medium/high: short-term borrowing and current-debt presentations may not be mutually exclusive in every issuer filing
leverage_definitions.economic_interpretation: Short-term borrowings plus current/non-current long-term debt; all three exclude an explicit operating-lease policy.
leverage_definitions.review_recommendation: Do not approve without issuer-level overlap controls and a documented short-term-debt policy.

signoff_recommendations.reason: 494/497 issuer source coverage in prior audit; exact US-GAAP net-income tag remains subject to USD, duration, PIT, and ambiguity controls.
490/497 issuer source coverage; exact stockholders-equity tag is an instant fact and avoids automatic NCI/partner/member substitutions.
497/497 issuer source coverage; exact Assets tag has the clearest source definition and is instant-only.
496/497 issuer source coverage; exact duration cash-flow tag is auditable without a continuing-operations fallback.
394/497 issuer source coverage; exact cash-payment tag is retained without acquisition/intangible fallbacks and negative-sign observations remain exceptions, not inversions.
Conservative DEV availability boundary supported by the source filed field; RDQ/intraday timing remains unavailable.

signoff_recommendations.proposed_rule: Amendment effective only from its own filing date
signoff_recommendations.reason: Prevents future amendment information from backfilling an earlier signal date; it does not resolve same-date ambiguity.
The raw facts contain non-USD units; a conversion source/rule has not been approved.
Balance-sheet and flow facts have different source date structures; mixing them would be a category error.

signoff_recommendations.proposed_rule: Period classification uses dates + form + FY/FP, not FP alone
signoff_recommendations.reason: The source exhibits irregular and comparative durations; multi-field classification is required to avoid treating FP labels as sufficient evidence.
